entities.name: Almagest
entities.label: Text
entities.summary:
The Almagest was a foundational astronomical treatise written by Claudius Ptolemy around 150 CE.\n
Ptolemy's work synthesized knowledge from ancient Babylonians, Egyptians, and Greeks to create a geocentric model of the universe, where Earth was at its center. This framework dominated Western astronomy for over 1,000 years, influencing the development of astronomy, navigation, and cartography.\n
The Almagest's influence extended beyond the scientific community, with its ideas shaping medieval Christian theology and influencing Islamic and Asian astronomical traditions. Its impact can still be seen in modern star charts and navigation systems.
